title: Gleaning
summary: Gleaning allowed the poor, widows, strangers, and vulnerable people to gather what remained after harvest.
background: The practice shows that Israel’s law included mercy within economic life. Ruth’s story displays providence, dignity, kindness, and covenant faithfulness through this background.
teachingHelp: When teaching Ruth or harvest laws, show both the practical mercy of the command and the providence of God in ordinary work.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
